## AI disclosure

<!--
AI-assisted contributions are welcome, but we require honesty about them. Being

-->

- [ ] No AI tools were used for this contribution.

If you used AI, briefly describe how (code generation, refactoring, tests,

If you have checked the box next to “AI tools were used,” please also confirm the following:

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test` passes locally
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated for any user-visible change
- [ ] The code follows the existing style (`cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy`, `ruff`)
- [ ] I have read the [Contributing guide](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](../blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [ ] I understand and take responsibility for every line in this pull request, including any AI-assisted parts
